Class ScenarioPresetManager

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.scenario.ScenarioPresetManager
public class ScenarioPresetManager extends Object
Controller managing Scenario preset selection, JSON export/import, persistence into the scenario repository, and dirty state tracking.

1.0.0-beta.2
